# JuicedTrade

> JuicedTrade is a free stock screener for Indian (NSE) and US (S&P 500) markets. It evaluates 110 trading strategies, adapted from classic trading literature and open-source quant research, against every stock daily. It also runs two autonomous paper-trading bots (an intraday trader and a long-term investor) and screens ETFs grouped by theme.

## What JuicedTrade does

- **Strategy screener.** Every stock in the active market evaluated against 110 named strategies; filter by category or buy/sell signal.
- **Multi-strategy scan.** Surfaces stocks where 2+ strategies agree on a BUY signal, ranked by confluence and strength.
- **Markets covered.** India (all 2,100+ NSE-listed equities) and United States (all 500 S&P 500 stocks). Switch with the header toggle.
- **ETF screener.** ~33 NSE ETFs and ~52 US ETFs grouped by theme (Broad Market, Sector, Thematic, Bonds, Commodities, International, Real Estate, Dividend, Volatility, Smart Beta) with a buy, hold, or sell call per ETF derived from trend, momentum, MACD, and strategy confluence.
- **Bot performance.** Two autonomous paper-trading bots per market, each with ₹10,00,000 (India) or $5,000 (US) starting capital and a multi-factor decision engine (trend, momentum, mean-reversion, volatility, plus a fundamental quality tilt for the long-term bot) with risk-based position sizing. The **Long-Term Investor** holds positions across days with a trailing stop and rotates into stronger names; the **Intraday Trader** takes same-day round trips and is flat overnight. Both hold at most 5 positions and reinvest profits (compounding). Each renders an equity curve with buy/sell markers.
- **Market overview.** Sensex/Nifty (India) or S&P 500/Dow/Nasdaq (US) with key levels, pivot points, fibonacci, ATR-based targets.
- **Global market cues.** 20+ world markets plus a quantitative prediction (0-100 score) for both India and US sessions, with weighted factor reasoning.
- **Signals dashboard.** 15+ buy/sell indicators, sentiment gauge, market events.
- **Backtesting.** One-click 1-year backtest on the primary index plus 5 cross-validation stocks, full trade-by-trade history.

## Strategy categories

The 110 strategies span 11 categories: Swing, Intraday, Advanced, Positional, Scalping, Options, Price Action, Value Investing, Candlestick, Trend Following, and Index Investing. They are drawn from classic trading literature, OpenBB signal concepts, and open-source quant/ML research (e.g. Donchian breakout, multi-factor momentum, z-score mean reversion, Hurst stat-arb).

## Pricing

Free during the public beta. No sign-up, no credit card, no paid tier.

## Disclaimer

JuicedTrade is an analytical and educational tool. It does not execute real trades, does not provide investment advice, and is not registered with SEBI or the SEC. Always do your own research and consult a licensed advisor before investing.
